previous_motion_baseline.integration: Stable control/calibration/servo web files and MCU protocol. Retain AI source ownership and independent ToF task. AppController blocks arming for nondefault legacy software zeros until all hardware centers are acknowledged. Chat/media/dual-mic/wake/mouth remain.

controller_adaptations.__init__: Retain AI control ownership, feedback pause and battery state, and track failed IMU loads.
controller_adaptations.command: Reject inactive inputs and ignore targets during a feedback pause.
controller_adaptations.status: Expose the input-source owner and feedback pause state.
controller_adaptations.receive_diagnostics: Keep the faster DQD2 voltage input for battery warnings beside the upstream per-servo DQV1 report.
controller_adaptations.set_mode: Apply the low-voltage interlock and resume after a feedback pause on explicit mode selection.
controller_adaptations.start_kick: Integrate servo-bus voltage telemetry and the low-voltage protection sequence.
controller_adaptations.set_sitstand: Integrate servo-bus voltage telemetry and the low-voltage protection sequence.
controller_adaptations.start_pick: Integrate servo-bus voltage telemetry and the low-voltage protection sequence.
controller_adaptations.start_roulade: Integrate servo-bus voltage telemetry and the low-voltage protection sequence.
controller_adaptations.cal_center: Integrate servo-bus voltage telemetry and the low-voltage protection sequence.
controller_adaptations.step: Keep battery warnings and hold last targets during a feedback pause. Cancel pending actions on loss.
controller_adaptations._sample_imu_calibration: Clear the AI arming interlock after a successful calibration.
controller_adaptations.reset_imu_calibration: Clear the AI arming interlock when a saved calibration is explicitly disabled.

transport_overlays.reason: Repair Router method registry after serial reconnect even when $/version still responds. Router 0.11.0 accepts a same-owner registration; Routers 0.5.4-0.10.x reject it with RouteAlreadyExists (code 5) while the route is intact, so that answer counts as registered.

Helper for the supervisor above: RouteAlreadyExists (code 5) means the route is still registered. Without it Routers 0.5.4-0.10.x reconnect the Bridge every 2.26 s and drop servo setup, calibration and walking modes. Host regression: tests/test_bridge_routes.py.

mcu_compatibility.calibration: Upstream hardware-center DQL2/DQA1/DQR2 and DQV2/DQS3 packets; legacy software centers are not applied.

gain_call_overlays.integrated: // Preserve each servo's existing KP/KD, including the mouth.

integration: Pinned master motion policies, heading hold, motion web pages and standing IMU calibration. The AI adapter retains control ownership, ToF avoidance, speech mouth, battery protection and feedback pause. The MCU keeps the existing motion ABI, AI Bridge registration and user-set gains while adding the master voltage report and manual saved/live KP/KD writes.
calibration: Keep old data/zero_pos.json unchanged as a backup only. Hardware centers live in each servo. Per-robot data/hardware-centers.json records acknowledged migration against the legacy file digest; failed/partial calibration cannot enable motion.

audio_cue_overlay.reason: Use 300 ms cues with 2× PCM amplitude for send and 3× for reply completion relative to the 0.2.34 assets.

local_aec_overlay.reason: Continuous local reference, compatible cloud abort, reply-generation isolation and optional AEC playback headroom; stable motion/web/MCU unchanged.

static_imu_calibration.integration: Master version 2 additive acceleration offset and gyro zero. Collect and apply them from the calibration page, save in persistent data/, and back up previous records when saving or resetting. Older rotation records require calibration before arming.

runtime_gains_overlay.scope: User-controlled per-servo gains, including the mouth. No gain writes on App/voice startup, respawn, MCU boot, arming, exclusive-mode transitions or timeout. Manual saved settings and on-demand runtime readback remain.

forward_avoidance_overlay.integration: Existing MCP stand/move/pick/roulade plus Sit, LeftKick, RightKick and SetWalkingMode. Cached forward-only walking/roller input limit uses the nearest current valid front ToF return. Missing, stale or invalid measurements leave forward input available. A stop cancels blocked MCP jobs and requires a new command. Held controls must release. The background monitor renews its read-only lease. MCP comment and wire-size test use the verified CN packet budget of 16000 bytes and 60 tools, including JSON escaping and envelope.

tof_mcp_outcome_overlay.integration: Read-only Duck.GetToF via authenticated local IPC returns the 5 Hz sensor grid and cached forward status, each with frame sequence/age. Expected obstacle/sensor pauses return successful MCP calls with blocked execution; retain actual parameter, permission and motion feedback/transport errors. Preflight, queued and racing forward blocks do not set a false motion error. No changes to controller math, guard thresholds, web assets, ONNX, audio or MCU.

forward_distance_defaults.scope: User-selected normal walking distances. Retain faster Roller distance margin, invalid/stale sensor stop, torque retention, three-frame release and new-command requirement.

previous_profile.scope: Fixed-speed ordinary forward entry without speed argument. Explicit slow/numeric Move keeps the supplied speed; omitted Move speed uses directional defaults. Phone RemoteMove, motion core, ToF rules, models and MCU unchanged. Restart the voice child to refresh the tool catalog.

normal_forward_defaults.scope: All MCP Move directions default to 0.1 m/s and reject speeds above 0.15, including Roller. Forward normal/fast profiles select 0.1/0.15. Explicit values within the cap are preserved. Web/core limits, angular rates, RemoteMove percentage mapping, ToF, models and MCU unchanged.

ai_binding_overlay.scope: Explicit browser selection of cn/global immediately saves via same-origin POST and voice IPC, then reconnects voice. No additional Apply button. Pending saves suppress repeated switches; failed or lost responses reconcile the actual persisted selection. Preserve identity, conversation language, audio and motion. Platform links, UI language and phone provisioning never select a cloud automatically. Initial UI language follows the accessing browser system language (Chinese locales use Chinese, all others English), ignoring persisted language overrides. Manual toggles are page-local and never change the cloud.
ai_binding_overlay.validation: Region HTTP and parent/voice IPC tests retained. UI lifecycle checks cover immediate save, duplicate suppression, rollback, lost-response reconciliation, close/reopen during save, stale connection isolation, idempotency, first selection, custom URL and preserved language. MCU, models and motion math unchanged. 13 locale/old-preference cases, temporary toggle and system languagechange checks passed.

speaker_test_overlay.scope: Add an explicit speaker-test control to the left of live microphone listening. Play bundled duck calls through the existing media audio handoff using source=duck; preserve music/upload/recording/TTS sources, uploaded content, volume, MCU and all motion code. No playback on page load. Pending requests suppress overlap; users can stop their test, and natural completion restores controls. Reconnect chat after media releases the device.
speaker_test_overlay.validation: Node VM cockpit lifecycle checks plus AudioHandoff and Runtime tests cover play/stop/finish, stale polling, errors, duplicate clicks, missing device, zh/en state, unchanged volume/uploads and chat resume.

startup_guide_overlay.scope: Explain one-time setup, boot autostart, ordered network/voice duck sounds and the xiao-ya wake phrase in both READMEs and the AI binding dialog. Browser-local sound examples use the actual connection cue kinds and software gain. Previews never command Duck or write its configuration, and stop on close, hide, page exit or a new selection. Runtime autostart, actual connection sound playback, motion, models, calibration and MCU are unchanged.

battery_overlay.description: Sample the median servo supply voltage and publish it in DQD2 diagnostics. Linux also accepts legacy DQD1 packets. At 6.0 V or below for five consecutive seconds, stop travel, play the configured language announcement, then disarm with a bounded wait.

cn.text: 当前电量低，请先关机充电，关机充电哦，我现在准备卸力了。

en.text: My battery is low. Please turn me off and charge me. Remember to turn me off before charging. I’m about to release my joints.

speech_mouth_overlay.description: Speech-mouth RMS updates, 100 Hz analysis and 50 Hz output, -3 to 30 degree range, 150 degrees/s limit and 100 ms DAC advance. Walking model calculations remain pinned to the upstream source after removing only the declared mouth overlays.

calibration_guide_overlay.scope: Calibration page only: three photo zones, 15 URDF pose references, bilingual instructions, in-page image enlargement and session progress. Canonical index mapping, calibration endpoints, MCU centering, stored centers, unload and foreground heartbeat rules are preserved. Late responses cannot reopen an exited session.

servo_gains_display_overlay.scope: Servo setup Read shows EEPROM KP/KD and runtime RAM KP/KD separately and compares them. Set KpKd refreshes both readbacks; failed reads remain unavailable. Existing read opcodes are reused sequentially. Confirmed unloaded servo-debug mode permits runtime reads; calibration and pending mode transitions stay blocked. No MCU firmware, gain writes, motion or calibration logic changes.

control_page_locale_overlay.scope: Control page at port 9527. The primary browser language selects simplified Chinese for zh, English otherwise. Localized labels, feedback, and common errors use the existing motion and calibration APIs. The manual switch translates the current status and labels in place.

servo_page_locale_overlay.scope: Servo setup uses simplified Chinese for a Chinese primary browser language and English otherwise. Navigation, setup, scanning, gain readback, and protection messages follow that locale. The calibration navigation uses 标定. The manual switch keeps the current scan and readback results.

cockpit_keyboard_and_presets_overlay.scope: Desktop keys and cockpit sticks share the bounded movement lease. Head and beak presets use the Mini Program targets. Default pose uses the existing Hold mode. Seven synthesized calls use the local USB audio handoff. The cockpit displays two rows of motion controls and a row of duck calls. On narrow touch screens the portrait view prompts for landscape and releases active steering.
